Root cause CONFIRMED by driven experiment (instrumented run_ensures under the recorded selection, then a 2s minimal pair):

POLLUTER: tests/unit/test_push_callers_best_effort.py:22 monkeypatches lock.canonical_tracker to a lambda returning its own tmp tracker, then calls event_append.write_and_push. event_append.py:350 lazily imports rebar._store.ensures for the FIRST time in the process; ensures.py:41 ('from rebar._store.lock import LockTimeout, canonical_tracker, write_lock') executed inside the patch window, permanently binding the test's lambda as ensures.canonical_tracker. monkeypatch teardown restores lock, not the captured copy.

VICTIM: every later run_ensures (ensures.py:163) canonicalized ANY tracker to the polluter's dead tmpdir — instrumentation printed raw=<victim tracker> canonical=<.../test_event_and_batch_append_ke0/.tickets-tracker> realpath_fn=<...test_event_and_batch_append_keep_the_default_push_contract.<locals>.<lambda>>. The init-time sweep (gc-config pins gc.autoDetach/maintenance.autoDetach=false, .gitignore/.gitattributes/.ensure-applied) landed in the wrong dir while reporting changed; the victim tracker stayed UNPINNED, its 'git commit' spawned 'git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach' (trace2 parent argv cited), and tests/_git_upkeep.py:203 correctly failed. The original 'origin gc threshold / trace scope' hypothesis is REJECTED: the fixture origin was pinned throughout; the detached child came from the tracker.

Re-confirmed reproducing on origin/main aeab106820 (the spawn_detached/snapshot-GC merges c98d976199/7213e082b5/a3da2f4cce did NOT fix or move the mechanism). Minimal pair: test_push_callers_best_effort.py + the inline upkeep test (deterministic, 2.4s).

FIX (class, not instance): ensures.py now late-binds via 'from rebar._store import lock as _lock' (the style event_append/sync/push already use; ensures was the only by-value importer of these names in src/rebar). RED->GREEN: new tests/unit/test_ensures_late_binding.py reproduces the patch-active first-import window and failed pre-fix, passes post-fix. Recorded 14-suite selection: 102 passed post-fix (2 runs). make lint, mypy, complexity ratchet (new=0 increased=0) green.
